nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: paste the ID of your ClaimLine-Data Google Sheet here. Every Google Sheets node in this workflow reads it from this one node.

nodes.name: Lookup Policy
nodes.notes: Always Output Data is ON. Without it, a policy number that matches nothing returns zero items, the branch stops dead, no Respond node ever fires, and the caller sits in silence until Retell times out.

nodes.name: Lookup Claim
nodes.notes: Always Output Data is ON so a fake claim ID still produces one (empty) item and the not-found response can be built and returned.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: 'unknown_action', received: $json.action, message: 'action must be one of validate_policy, create_claim, check_status.' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — Unknown Action
nodes.notes: Safety net. A typo in the Retell function's `action` value would otherwise leave the branch with nowhere to go and the caller in dead air.
